description: Reads the user's resume the way an applicant tracking system (ATS) does and scores it: readiness score (0-100), verdict, per-category scores, every failed check with its evidence and fix, and the fields an ATS would store (name, contact, roles, education, skills). With a job posting it adds the job match score and each requirement judged. Advice that is not scored (the file, age signals, a named ATS's documented notes) comes apart from the score. The score comes from a published, deterministic rubric (the same file always gets the same score), not from an AI model; present it as the rubric's result, not your own judgement. Use it only on the user's own resume, at their request: it is a tool for candidates. Never use it to screen, rank, compare or reject other people. Runs locally and reads only the files named in the call; nothing is sent anywhere.

job_path.description: Path to a job posting: .txt, .md, .pdf, .docx, or a saved .html page. Optional; give job_path or job_text.

job_text.description: The job posting as text. Optional; give job_path or job_text, not both.

path.description: Absolute path to the user's resume: .pdf, .docx, .html, .txt, .md, or a .json JSON Resume or ats-resume document. Give path or text, not both.

region.description: Read the resume as from this country (US, DE, FR, GB, IN). Default: inferred from it.

target_ats.description: The applicant tracking system the user is applying through (greenhouse, lever, taleo), to add its vendor's documented notes, each with its source. Advice only; never scored.

text.description: The resume as plain text, when there is no file. Give path or text, not both.

name: check_resume

advice.description: Not scored: the file (name, size, password, tracked changes), details that can invite age bias where the region calls for it, and a named ATS's documented notes.

failedChecks.description: Every failed check, with its evidence and fix.

jobMatchScore.description: 0-100, how well the resume meets the posting.

matchedKeywordGroups.description: The same terms by kind; soft skills weigh less in the match.

missingKeywordGroups.description: The same terms by kind; soft skills weigh less in the match.

requirements.description: Each requirement of the posting, judged.

job.description: The match against the posting; null when no posting was given.

parsed.description: The fields an ATS would store from this resume.

items.description: A certification or licence, with when it was earned and when it expires.
A language the candidate speaks, with its level as written and on the CEFR.

readinessScore.description: 0-100, how well an ATS reads and ranks the resume.

title: Check my resume
